SHORT_DESCRIPTION: 75 MW SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC (PV) POWER PLANT IN FREE STATE PROVINCE, THROUGH CASTALIA LLC
PROJECT_TITLE: 75 MW Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Power Plant in Free State Province, through Castalia LLC
LONG_DESCRIPTION: A USTDA grant of $1,019,889 in support of Pele Green Energy (Pty) Ltd (Grantee) to fund a feasibility study (Study) to assess the technical, financial and economic viability of a 75 megawatt solar photovoltaic power plant near the town of Luckhoff in the Free State province of South Africa (Project). The U.S. firm Castalia LLC will perform the Study. The Study will provide the Grantee with the necessary technical, financial, and commercial analyses required for preparing a competitive proposal in response to Round 5 of South Africa's Renewable Energy Independent Power Producer Procurement Programme. The Study will also assess options for the Project to sell its output directly to interested municipalities, private sector industries or a bulk energy trader.

These sub-projects will provide power to residential, commercial and industrial end users directly or through a wheeling arrangement with municipal distribution companies.
